input: Find evening and weekend summer programs for kids and teens for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell, McDowell and Rutherford counties, NC, and Johnson City, TN. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: 2026 VBS Madison Mars Hill Marshall Hot Springs NC
Johnson City TN summer 2026 youth evening clinics camp

candidates.note: 2025 VBS for grades K–8, July 13–16, 5:30–8 p.m.; dinner, lessons, games and crafts.
